items.title: UnitedHealth Sinks 5% on Medicare Advantage Audit Plan as CMS Moves to “Crush” Medical Fraud
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUnitedHealth fell 5% after CMS proposed clawing back Medicare Advantage overpayments as far back as payment year 2018, and Humana and CVS Health fell too. CMS estimates the audits would recover about $9 billion per payment year industry-wide, and UnitedHealth hasn’t sized its share.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stocks Fall 4.62% as CMS Proposes Wider Medicare Advantage Audits
items.summary: The CRUSH rule would extrapolate audit findings from payment year 2018 and recover about $9 billion a year in overpayments.

items.title: Humana Stocks Fall 4.24% as CMS Targets $9 Billion Yearly in Overpayments
items.summary: The proposed CRUSH rule would extrapolate Medicare Advantage audit findings back to payment year 2018, with comments due January 19.
